data.name: Title
data.value: Hand-off

data.name: Description
data.value: When a question is beyond the local model, Jarvis can hand it over to a cloud model. Nothing is handed over until you choose a target here.

data.name: LeavesLabel
data.value: What leaves this computer

data.name: Leaves_Request
data.value: Your request and the recent conversation, word for word, go to the provider you choose, over the Internet.

data.name: Leaves_Tools
data.value: If that model uses a reading tool that is turned on (a file of an allowed folder, a web page), the result goes to it too.

data.name: Leaves_Memory
data.value: The facts Jarvis keeps about you and the summary of the old exchanges do not go, unless you tick the box below.

data.name: Leaves_Never
data.value: Never: a secret, the content of the vault, a sound.

data.name: Cost
data.value: Each question handed over is billed by the provider. A monthly cap bounds these calls: it is set on the Spending page, with the prices.

data.name: QuestionsLabel
data.value: Target for questions

data.name: QuestionsHint
data.value: For a question the local model cannot treat: long reasoning, expert knowledge, careful writing. One of the cloud providers of the « Language models » page.

data.name: None
data.value: None: nothing is handed over

data.name: NoProvider
data.value: No cloud provider is configured. Add an Anthropic or OpenAI provider on the « Language models » page first.

data.name: NoTarget
data.value: No target: nothing leaves for a cloud provider.

data.name: Chosen
data.value: Jarvis says « I am asking {0} » then gives its answer. The requests go to {1}.

data.name: MemoryLabel
data.value: Memory

data.name: WithMemory
data.value: Also send what Jarvis keeps about me

data.name: WithMemoryHint
data.value: Off: only the request and the recent conversation leave. On: the kept facts and the summary go with each question.

data.name: TasksLabel
data.value: Target for tasks

data.name: TasksLater
data.value: A work on files or in several steps will go to Claude Code. This target is not available yet.

data.name: PhrasesLabel
data.value: Forcing the hand-off

data.name: PhrasesHint
data.value: At the start of a request, spoken or typed, these words send what follows straight to the target, without the local model.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The settings cannot be written.

data.name: Spend
data.value: Cloud this month: {0} USD out of {1} USD.

data.name: SpendReached
data.value: Cloud this month: {0} USD out of {1} USD. The cap is reached: nothing is handed over until next month, or until the cap is raised.

data.name: NoPrice
data.value: no price

data.name: ChosenNoPrice
data.value: This target has no price any more: nothing is handed over until one is typed on the Spending page.

data.name: PriceNote
